title: AGNO WFM — Module 10 AI Layer (Phase 8 Dashboard)

panels.title: AI interaction volume & latency (§0.5) — by interaction_type
ai_interaction_duration_seconds — p50/p95/p99 by interaction_type (full round trip: gRPC fan-out + LLM call)
ai_interactions_total — rate by interaction_type (FinOps volume signal, §0.5)
LLM API health & circuit breaker (Phase 7/docs/adr/0128, BYOK multi-provider docs/adr/0117/0129)
ai_llm_api_calls_total — rate by result (success/error/timeout/short_circuited)
panels.description: A rising `short_circuited` share means the breaker is protecting the system from an already-detected outage, not that the provider is newly failing - see MetricsService's own doc comment. Not split by provider (anthropic/openai/gemini/ollama) - this metric has no provider label (docs/adr/0128's own considered-and-skipped third label dimension); provider-specific breakdown is only visible in application logs.

panels.title: ai_circuit_breaker_state_transitions_total — rate by to_state
panels.description: Any sustained `open` rate with no matching `closed` shortly after is the on-call page condition: a provider (anthropic/openai/gemini/ollama - not distinguished by this metric) has been failing long enough to trip the breaker and isn't recovering.

panels.title: ai_degraded_mode_interactions_total — rate by interaction_type
panels.description: `nl_query` (askQuestion, Phase 6/docs/adr/0127) never appears as a *served* degraded interaction here in the usual sense - it throws AiAssistantUnavailableError to the caller instead of returning a degraded response, but the row is still recorded and still counted here.

panels.title: ai_tenant_scope_assertion_failures_total — rate by source_module (§5.1, a security-relevant event)
panels.description: §0.5's on-call table: any non-zero rate here is worth alerting on immediately, not trending - it means a gRPC response returned data scoped to a different tenant than the one that asked (docs/adr/0118, durable-audit-backed).

panels.title: ai_recommendations_by_autonomy_level_total — rate by autonomy_level, all tenants
panels.description: A sudden shift toward `auto_execute_low_risk` worth a human glance - it means non-negotiable #1's write-back pathway (ADR-0124) is firing without a human decision more often, not necessarily a problem, but the one autonomy level where this dashboard's own volume trend is most worth watching.

panels.title: HTTP/GraphQL request duration — p99 by route (Query.<field>/Mutation.<field> for GraphQL)

options.content:
**RBAC guard rejections (401/403) are invisible to every panel above.** Phase 8's `AccessTokenGuard`/`PermissionsGuard` (docs/adr/0130) run as NestJS Guards, which execute *before* `HttpMetricsInterceptor` in the request lifecycle (Guards → Interceptors → Handler) - a request a guard rejects never reaches the interceptor that records `http_requests_total`/`http_request_duration_seconds` at all. There is currently no metric anywhere that counts RBAC denials; the only record of one is the GraphQL error response itself and, if logging is scraped, the stack trace NestJS's default exception handling logs. A real gap for a security-relevant control, disclosed here rather than silently assumed covered by the general HTTP metrics.

**No metric distinguishes which BYOK provider (anthropic/openai/gemini/ollama) is failing.** `ai_llm_api_calls_total`/`ai_circuit_breaker_state_transitions_total` are both provider-agnostic by design (docs/adr/0128's own considered-and-skipped third label dimension, given only two providers existed when that decision was made - now four). Diagnosing *which* provider is behind a circuit-open alert currently requires reading application logs, not this dashboard.

**No Prometheus alerting rule exists for any panel on this dashboard** - confirmed platform-wide, not a Module 10-specific gap (ADR-0107's own precedent finding for Module 08).

**This dashboard reflects one process's own in-memory circuit-breaker state** (docs/adr/0128) - a future multi-replica deployment would need per-instance breakdown (or a shared state store) to be meaningful, since `ai_circuit_breaker_state_transitions_total` aggregated across replicas could show `open` and `closed` simultaneously from different instances.
